title: CampaignRecord
description: One marketing campaign. The registry tracks its state + where its artifacts live (copy, Apollo sequence, Gamma deck); the tools own the execution. `campaign_id` is the unique key; `repo`, when set, must exist in repos.jsonl.

sku.description: linked SKU id, e.g. sku_001; null if company-level

repo.description: promoted repo (owner/name) — must exist in repos.jsonl; null if none

apollo_sequence_id.description: Apollo emailer sequence id, if any
